methods.name: Tasseled Cap Transformation (TCT) change detection
methods.summary: The method uses the Tasseled Cap Transformation (TCT) to process pre- and post-event Sentinel-2 images. It calculates the difference in Brightness, Greenness, and Wetness indices, which are then combined into an RGB composite to identify landslide-driven spectral changes.
methods.source: Index Data Base for Sentinel-2 sensor
methods.verbatim: The TCT Brightness, Wetness and Greenness indices were produced for the pre-event and post-event satellite images by using the following equation... where B2, B3, B4, B8, B10, B11, and B12 are the Sentinel-2 bands (see Table 2) while the letters from A to G are the TCT coefficients suggested by the Index Data Base for Sentinel-2 sensor (https://www.indexdatabase.de).

availability.author_statement: The datasets used and/or analysed during the current study available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and accessible, and input datasets are available, but the custom code used for the Tasseled Cap Transformation is not provided or linked. The author statement indicates data is available only upon request, which does not meet the criteria for availability.
